args.title: Remember last selected export format
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Enhance the ExportButton component to remember the last export format chosen by the user. This can be achieved by storing the selected format in local storage and using it as the default format upon component initialization. This aligns with the feature request to remember the format across sessions.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is about remembering the user's last chosen export format. The `ExportButton` component currently defaults to "CSV" and does not store or restore the user's last choice. Implementing this feature could be done by using local storage to save the selected format and using it as the `defaultFormat` when initializing the component. I'll open a draft PR for this.
